title: Movilización política
goal: Read three landmark moments of Indigenous political mobilization: Ecuador's 1990 CONAIE uprising, Mexico's January 1994 Zapatista rebellion, and the Bolivian movements around Evo Morales and the Water and Gas Wars.

items: Describe what CONAIE organized in Ecuador in 1990.
Explain what happened in Chiapas on January 1, 1994.
Explain what Bolivia's Water War (2000) and Gas War (2003) showed.
Describe the role of Evo Morales's coca-grower federations in Bolivia's road blockades.
Use al grito de to introduce a mobilizing slogan.
